title: Pantheon Ops foundation hardening program
goal: Close the minimum architecture, authorization, consistency, lifecycle, and quality gaps required for VM service lifecycle and reliable Kubernetes management.

in: business module ownership and cross-module typed capability boundaries
BizScope data-domain enforcement and CMDB ownership
Deploy idempotency, leases, callbacks, and service-instance state transitions
Kubernetes release reliability and resource state-machine contracts
architecture, overlay, frontend, and evidence quality gates
out: generic platform/system capability changes in pantheon-base
copying all Kubernetes objects into CMDB

globalRules: Business modules access only tables they own.
Cross-module reads use provider-owned Reader or Capability APIs.
Cross-module writes use provider-owned Command APIs.
Cross-module DTOs never expose GORM models.
Same-process boundaries use typed Go interfaces; HTTP or gRPC is reserved for deployment boundaries.
Existing dirty-tree changes must be preserved.
maintainerGates: pantheon-base ownership or foundation version change
incompatible public contracts between child tasks
unresolvable collision with pre-existing worktree edits
